Both disclosures address the corporate strategy and goal of matching 100% of global electricity usage for offices and data centers with renewable energy. The 2024 disclosure cites a 44% match in FY2023 and the FY2025 target. The 2025 disclosure confirms the commitment starting FY2025 and reports progress to 76% in FY2024. They share the same specific subject of renewable energy matching strategy and targets.

Disclosure D054 asserts that FY2023 metrics were published in May 2023 and FY2024 metrics are expected in H1 FY2025. Disclosure D063 contains the counterpart assertion that FY2024 metrics are published in May 2024 and FY2025 metrics are expected in H1 FY2026. These disclosures share the specific topic of the timeline and status of environmental sustainability metrics publication for consecutive fiscal years. Although the previous alignment attempt failed due to citing unselected audit sentences, D063 contains the relevant selected sentences (S002, S003) that correspond to the 'expected publication' and 'no material impact' aspects of the topic, making it the supported counterpart.

comparisons.peer_topic: 2024 Renewable Electricity Target and Compensation Linkage
comparisons.peer_summary: Intel linked a portion of executive and employee performance bonuses to a 2024 target of achieving 95% renewable electricity use globally, continuing a practice initiated over the past two decades to reduce climate change impact.
comparisons.comparison: Both NVIDIA and Intel disclose specific renewable electricity targets and progress. NVIDIA aims to match 100% of its global office and data center electricity usage with renewable energy by the end of fiscal year 2025, having reached 44% in fiscal year 2023. Intel similarly targets renewable electricity usage, linking executive and employee performance bonuses to a 2024 target of achieving 95% renewable electricity use globally, building on two decades of reducing climate change impacts.

sentences.text: By the end of fiscal year 2025, our goal is to purchase or generate enough renewable energy to match 100% of our global electricity usage for our offices and data centers.
In fiscal year 2023, we increased the percentage of our total electricity use matched by renewable energy purchases to 44%.

We focus on reducing our own climate change impact, and over the past two decades have reduced our direct and indirect greenhouse gas emissions associated with energy consumption and invested in renewable electricity and on-site alternative energy projects.

In 2024, continuing our practice of linking a portion of our executive and employee performance bonus to our corporate sustainability metrics, we linked a portion of the performance bonus to our 2024 target to reach 95% renewable electricity use globally.
